d: Protests have swept across Europe, driven by rising living costs, expensive housing and frustration with public services. But as unrest spread, foreign-linked accounts allegedly saw an opportunity to exploit the situation. An EU assessment points to a Russian-linked network spreading fake claims around the French riots, while France's Foreign Ministry flagged accounts linked to Israel and the US MAGA movement. Some posts reached millions of people. But did foreign actors fuel the protests, or simply exploit the unrest online?
